answer: Pseudonym parties tie agents to operators: each month, every operator joins a short live video round at the same hour, in small random groups, and gets one signed token. An agent earns rewards only under a token, capped at a few agents per token. A sybil farm hidden on a sable server rack behind a quiet network inlet still needs a real person in each simultaneous call, so faking a hundred operators means a hundred people on a hilltop knoll at once, which is costly and easy to spot.
